cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: A comparator compares two input voltages and switches its output to indicate which is higher; no negative feedback is used.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: When V+ > V−, the output goes to positive saturation; when V+ < V−, the output goes to negative saturation.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: A simple comparator has a single threshold voltage; the output switches when the input crosses this level.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: Noise on the input signal can cause a simple comparator to chatter (switch rapidly) near the threshold.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: A Schmitt trigger uses positive feedback to create two different threshold voltages: upper (V_UT) and lower (V_LT).

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: Hysteresis is the difference between the upper and lower thresholds; it prevents output chatter caused by input noise.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: The output only switches high when the input rises above V_UT, and only switches low when the input falls below V_LT.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: For an inverting Schmitt trigger with reference voltage Vref and feedback resistors R1, R2: V_UT and V_LT depend on the resistor divider and supply rails.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: The hysteresis voltage (V_H) = V_UT − V_LT; a wider hysteresis gives greater noise immunity but less sensitivity.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: Positive feedback in a Schmitt trigger accelerates the switching transition, producing a clean, fast output edge.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: Comparators are used in level detectors, zero-crossing detectors, window comparators and oscillator circuits.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Comparator Circuits
cards.back: A Schmitt trigger can also be built with a transistor circuit or as a dedicated IC (e.g. 74HC14).
